rooms.notes: East boundary steps around a dogleg pier shared with the small 113.6 NSF office to the east (not a target room; not traced) -- rule 5 stepped/offset faces. Confirmed by direct zoom crop (roseburg/pier-zoom2.png, roseburg/pier-check.png) that the pier's inner (D105A-facing) corner is a single continuous line at x=4126.1 -> y=2118.6 -> x=4290.4, both endpoints literally shared with the horizontal jog segment. Two doors: west to D105B, south to D105 (each notched per rule 3). North and NE walls are exterior; no further openings found there besides the D105/113.6-office door pair (which belongs to D105 and the 113.6 office, not to D105A). Printed NSF on the sheet is a space-inventory figure, not the drawn area; do not reconcile the ring to it. v2: east stub face 4290.4 -> 4303.8 (jamb corner at 4290.4,2359.3 kept; face runs 4290.4->4303.8 at y 2359.3 then north). The 4280.6/4290.4 pair is the drawn door leaf standing open (rule 1: a leaf never defines the boundary); the hatch runs to 4303.8, the wall face. Found by zoom after the first blind candidate run; changed on the rule, not to match the candidate.

rooms.notes: Largest, reference room for scale derivation. Three doors: two side-by-side in the north wall (to D105A and to the small 113.6 NSF office, mirror-image swing arcs sharing a ~54px mullion, confirmed by direct zoom crop roseburg/office113-full.png and roseburg/pier-zoom.png) and one south to corridor E124. The two north doors' swing arcs are drawn resting flush against the adjacent pier walls when open, which is what made the hinge geometry legible. Printed NSF on the sheet is a space-inventory figure, not the drawn area; do not reconcile the ring to it.
